humanReviewedWorkflow.behavior: Consumes the exact persisted adoption, submission and independent approval receipt chain; verifies source and target pins; requires enrolled execution authority; qualifies the complete target set before any signing; publishes under a separate workload without changing human provenance.

coordinatedActivation.behavior: Extends the shared transactional adoption mechanism to signed compiled product groups. Requires signed coordination evidence and execution authority, locks heads in sorted order, stages and verifies every member, qualifies the prospective set, then activates in one target transaction. Exact replay is supported and partial activation is rejected.
coordinatedActivation.atomicity: Per target database only; no cross-database atomicity claim.
coordinatedActivation.rollbackEvidence: Unit tests with a transactional repository double; no live group activation or rollback performed.
